correctness.rationale: Every edge imposes an independent 2-by-2 determinant condition. Nontrivial runs are projective one-dimensional blocks, adjacent zeros forced, singleton supports not retained. Zero projections, joint rank-one projections and line ratios prove injectivity of canonical data. Determinization of the three-bit coding yields a seven-state weighted automaton whose resolvent gives the rational function. A standalone checker compares actual finite-field rowspaces and independent support-word enumeration, including nonprime q=4; finite tests are not the general proof.

value.rationale: The number of distinct embedded element-centralizer subalgebras is a natural invariant of a finite Lie algebra, not determined by centralizer size distribution. The complete exact polynomial sequence and compact rational generating function over every finite field reflect nontrivial equality-of-kernel identifications. This provides a useful structural companion to existing graph Lie class-count formulas.
